literal_source_claim_en: The relation between contour integrals and residues.
candidate_family_not_credited_as_stateme: For a source-selected meromorphic complex function and eligible closed contour avoiding its finitely many relevant poles, the contour integral equals two pi i times a source-selected weighted or unweighted finite sum of residues.
statement_blocker: The catalog gives only a relation between contour integrals and residues. It supplies no source edition, contour or cycle model, domain and homology conditions, meromorphicity neighborhood, pole-set construction, residue definition, winding-number convention, normalization, ordered binders, boundary cases, or exact equality. Choosing a familiar general or simple-contour formulation would add proposition-changing mathematics.
domain_and_universes: Open: an approved source must fix the complex domain or region, contour or cycle carrier and regularity, scalar-valued meromorphic function, pole and residue representations, winding-number convention, universes, and all typeclass assumptions.
conclusion: Open: expected family is a contour-integral equality with a finite residue sum, but the catalog does not specify winding weights, orientation, pole set, sign, factor two pi i, or the exact equality encoding.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded before a source proposition is selected; constant or reversed paths, zero-radius circles, empty pole sets, removable or repeated singularities, poles on or outside the contour, nontrivial winding, and non-meromorphic points must be resolved and mutation-tested later.
